subtests.name: Each direction refers to its own scroll button
A physical direction returns the CSSPseudoElement of the logical direction it maps to
Physical directions map according to the writing mode
selectorText of ::scroll-button() includes the logical direction
selectorText of ::scroll-button() with a physical direction is the logical direction it maps to
selectorText of ::scroll-button() with a physical direction depends on the writing mode
selectorText of ::scroll-button() with a physical direction depends on the direction
pseudo() returns a CSSPseudoElement for ::scroll-button() of a disconnected element
